task_definition.task_description: Please check AAPL, then get the USD to JPY exchange rate and assess the risk for a $300 trade. After that, place a limit order for AAPL at 150.0 using the approved risk result, then look up Alice’s contact details and send her a high-priority app alert saying the order was executed successfully.

user_input.query: Please check AAPL first, then get the USD to JPY exchange rate and assess the risk for a $300.0 trade. After the order goes through, look up alice’s contact details and send her a high-priority app alert letting her know the AAPL order was executed successfully.
